name: Phenoxypropazine
summary: Phenoxypropazine (trade name Drazine) is an irreversible and non-selective monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine family. It was introduced as an antidepressant in 1961, but was subsequently withdrawn in 1966 due to hepatotoxicity concerns.

pharmacology.text: Phenoxypropazine (trade name Drazine) is an irreversible and non-selective monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine family.

uses.text: It was introduced as an antidepressant in 1961, but was subsequently withdrawn in 1966 due to hepatotoxicity concerns.

summaryZh: 苯氧丙肼是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C9H14N2O，為一種不可逆的非選擇性的聯氨類單胺氧化酶抑制劑，1961年作為抗抑鬱藥上市銷售，但在1966年因其存在肝毒性而撤回。

sideEffects.en: MAO inhibitors of the hydrazine class can cause a dangerous rise in blood pressure when certain foods or medicines are taken, and they can cause liver damage, dizziness and sleep disturbance.
sideEffects.zh: 肼類單胺氧化酶抑制劑在攝取某些食物或藥物時，可能造成血壓危險升高，也可能引起肝損傷、頭暈與睡眠障礙。
sideEffects.zhHans: 肼类单胺氧化酶抑制剂在摄取某些食物或药物时，可能造成血压危险升高，也可能引起肝损伤、头晕与睡眠障碍。

fact.en: Introduced as an antidepressant in 1961, it was withdrawn in 1966 because of liver damage, the fate of several hydrazine MAO inhibitors of that decade.
fact.zh: 它在 1961 年作為抗憂鬱藥問世，1966 年因肝損傷撤市，這也是那十年間多種肼類單胺氧化酶抑制劑的命運。
fact.zhHans: 它在 1961 年作为抗忧郁药问世，1966 年因肝损伤撤市，这也是那十年间多种肼类单胺氧化酶抑制剂的命运。
